reviews.title: Horrible Meta Ad
reviews.text: Wow this is ultimate suckatude. I installed 3 x.  Every time I was led into a merry go round of an ongoing annoying ad requiring me to get a Meta AI agent.    Never could escape the loop. It kind of reminded me of Conspiracy Theory  when he was escaping the gravy,  a true horror show for our modern times.

reviews.title: Major big waste of time. USELESS
reviews.text: This app is really nothing but clickbait and nothing but continuous commercial after commercial to get you to get other applications for blood tests, etc. I deleted it after five minutes. Everything is a pop-up for something else to buy.
